title: Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its employees, saying "automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate" (Liam Proven/The Register)
summary: Liam Proven / The Register: Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its employees, saying “automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate” — One in ten employees at SUSE are facing the chop due to “automation and AI,” according to a memo dispatched by management …
contentText:
Liam Proven / The Register :

Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its employees, saying “automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate”   —  One in ten employees at SUSE are facing the chop due to “automation and AI,” according to a memo dispatched by management …
